reason: ADR-0109's parity argument is that the CPM engine, the REST API and the database are untouched — apps/web only, which is what makes the whole redesign revertible by one commit. That claim was made in four commit messages, an ADR and this repository's operating manual before anybody armed the gate that proves it; it was verified by hand at M5 (`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- apps/api packages` is empty) and armed here so the remaining milestones cannot quietly break it. A hand-verified claim is exactly the kind ADR-0058 says to replace with a check. Remove it in this epic's closing pass — the previous declaration outlived its epic by weeks and went wrong about a different one.
